scenes.name: 02-hook
scenes.prompt: What am I looking at on the globe?
scenes.reply: You're looking at Earth from space — a full-globe view about 18,000 km out, looking straight down. The globe is rotating.

scenes.name: 03-hermes-globe
scenes.prompt: Fly to Tokyo and switch to night vision.

scenes.name: 04-feeds
scenes.prompt: Fly to the San Francisco Ferry Building and turn on flights, ships, satellites, and weather.

scenes.name: 05-pin-research
scenes.prompt: Fly to the Sydney Opera House. Pin it, research it, and open its pin drawer.

scenes.name: 06-director
scenes.prompt: Create a Director scene of Tokyo Tower with a north-east approach and overhead shot, then play it.

scenes.name: 07-fire-check
scenes.prompt: Zoom into the 2021 Caldor Fire and show the CAL FIRE perimeter. Then compare the forest before versus after.

scenes.name: 08-transit-follow
scenes.prompt: Find the nearest public aircraft near Toronto Pearson and follow it on the globe.

scenes.name: 09-imagery-time
scenes.prompt: Compare Hollywood Park's racetrack with SoFi Stadium — before and after, side by side.

scenes.name: 10-overlays
scenes.prompt: Near Richmond, pin Kew, Richmond, and Hampton. Add a Kew-to-Park route and open the Overlays sidebar.
